latin: Cur naturalis sit homini modus cognoscendi per rationem phantasiae coniunctam.
translation: Why it is natural to man to have a mode of knowing through reason joined to phantasy.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch11, from Latin at farmer1998:24622
not_established: No scholarship in the sources consulted discusses this thesis individually; text and cross-reference are from Farmer's edition alone (farmer1998:24622).
translation_note: 'phantasia' is kept close to its scholastic sense, the internal sense also called imagination (farmer1998:24622).
